title: Arithmetic purity of strong approximation for complete intersections of large dimension
summary: In this paper, we prove that for a smooth complete intersection $X\subset \mathbb{P}^n$ of type $(d_1,\dots,d_c)$ over a number field $k$, there exists an effective bound $N_{\mathrm{AP}}(d_1,\dots,d_c)$ such that if $n\ge N_{\mathrm{AP}}(d_1,\dots,d_c)$, then $X$ satisfies arithmetic purity of strong approximation. We establish a connecting lemma that promotes weak approximation to strong approximation under a suitable connectivity hypothesis via rational curves over $k$.
